lesson_title: Viewpoints, Self-Representation and the Social Significance of Representation

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to dominant and contested representations and the rise of self-representation.

items.title: Stuart Hall's Representation Theory Explained! — The Media Insider
items.description: Concise guide to how Hall's theory explains dominant and oppositional viewpoints — core to understanding contested representations.

items.title: Are You Living an Insta Lie? Social Media Vs. Reality — Ditch the Label
items.description: Shows how self-representation on social media differs from lived reality — a modern angle on the lesson's key ideas.

items.title: The Social Dilemma (2020)
items.description: Tech insiders explain how social platforms shape self-representation and identity — highly relevant to this lesson's focus on digital self-representation.

items.title: Get Out (2017)
items.description: Jordan Peele's horror film about racial misrepresentation and the social consequences of stereotyping — one of the most discussed representation texts in recent film.

items.title: AQA GCSE Media Studies — Specification & Past Papers
items.description: Official AQA page with the full specification and past papers for GCSE Media Studies 8572.

items.title: Ofcom — Media Use and Attitudes Research
items.description: Ofcom research on how different groups consume and are affected by media representations.
